import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        int[] data = new int[n];
        String[] inputLine = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            data[i] = Integer.parseInt(inputLine[i]);
        }
        Arrays.sort(data);
        int start = -1, end = 0, threshold, max_group = 0;
        threshold = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        while (end != n) {
            start++;
            while (end < n && data[end] - data[start] <= threshold) {
                end++;
            }
            max_group = Math.max(max_group, end - start);
        }
        System.out.println(max_group);
    }
}
